headline: After the ICJ ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, Rohingya-origin families in Karachi face an uncertain future over documentation and citizenship, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Karachi ki 20 bastiyon mein 150,000 se 200,000 Rohingya abaad

caption:
Karachi ke Rohingya khandano ka mustaqbal ab bhi ghair yaqeeni! 🤲
Arab News ke mutabiq International Court of Justice (ICJ) ne nine-six votes se faisla diya hai ke Myanmar ne 2017 mein Rakhine State mein Rohingya Musalmanon ki nasl kushi (genocide) ki. Is faisle se ummeed jagi hai, lekin 2017 se pehle Pakistan aa kar basne wale khandano ke shanakhti kaghzat aur shehriyat ke masle hal nahi hue. Upbuild Foundation ki 2025 ki study ke mutabiq Karachi ki 20 bastiyon mein 150,000 se 200,000 Rohingya rehte hain, aur zyada tar gharon ki mahana aamdani Rs25,000 se kam hai. Kai naujawan taleem ke zariye aage barhne ki koshish kar rahe hain.
Aap ke khayal mein in khandano ki madad kaise ho sakti hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
